subject.title: Expose structured progress metrics in hook events for plugin-based live progress cards

question: Should OpenClaw add structured progress metrics to existing plugin hook events, and which runtime source should own step totals, percentages, ETA, and terminal metrics across producers?
rationale: This is feasible as an additive SDK change, but it creates public progress semantics that could mislead plugin UIs unless maintainers choose the source of truth and absent-value rules.

options.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
options.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime can produce authoritative values, document absent unknowns, and test the affected producers.

options.title: Keep current hook payloads
options.body: Leave plugins to derive phase-only progress from existing tool and lifecycle events until a stronger progress source exists.

options.title: Design a separate progress event
options.body: Introduce a dedicated progress event or agent-event projection instead of attaching percentages to tool and terminal hooks.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
recommendation.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime can produce authoritative values, document absent unknowns, and test the affected producers.

likelyOwner.reason: The current history points to vincentkoc for public hook contract shape and this decision affects Plugin SDK semantics.
